name: beyond_get_lineage
description: Retrieve bounded resumable lineage. entity_id or attribute_ids required initially, cursor for subsequent pages. context/focused defaults; logical collapses only connected processor ports. Collect all pages via next_cursor and inspect complete, exhaustive, policy_limited and stop_reasons before absence claims. Cursor freezes query scope/policy/depth, permits budget changes, expires after 10 minutes, is process-local (same MCP worker required), and is invalidated by project edits or permission loss. Each page contains only its own edges; graph continuation is distinct from JSON transport paging. complete/exhaustive describe this response alone; traversal_complete describes accumulated traversal. The last page alone remains incomplete when prior pages exist. context returns direct_detail and remote_summary records with interpretation metadata. Repeated summary IDs across pages are additive fragments, not duplicates; process each page_index once. Explicit physical preserves legacy detail shape. Coverage contract: traversal_complete and traversal_stop_reasons describe graph coverage within scope. response_complete means all graph pages have been produced; requires_prior_pages means earlier pages must still be combined. next_cursor resumes graph exploration, not just transport. complete/exhaustive are deprecated compatibility fields. Transport fragments use transport_complete and must be assembled separately. Absence claims apply only to modeled accessible references in the declared scope.

attribute_ids.description: Root attribute IDs; narrow wide entities to at most 64 roots.

lineage_depth.description: Depth is independent of fan-out/edge budget. A depth boundary with remaining links returns complete=false and depth_limit.

lineage_view.description: context (default): direct physical references in detail, then grouped logical stages. physical: all reference detail. logical: collapsed stage paths. Read response interpretation for why, omitted details, scope, and page-delta merge rules.

lineage_policy.description: focused: direct stage includes all supported references, subsequent upstream MAP / downstream QUERY_PARAMETER. impact: all supported attribute paths. SEMANTIC/RELATION excluded in both. focused never supports exhaustive absence claims.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token; use with same active project and MCP worker.

output_contract_note: No outputSchema is declared by the inspected public source definition. Consult live help and actual results; do not infer a missing output contract.
